title: I made a free multiplayer horror game called NIGHT SHIFT! 👻
author: jaimeOnil2007
selftext:
Game Title: NIGHT SHIFT

Playable Link: https://app.joinhandshake.com/ai-showcase/projects/3554783?utm\_source=web&utm\_campaign=project\_share&utm\_medium=copy\_link&utm\_content=stu-copy\_link-project\_page

It's on "View project"

Platform: Web Browser (PC and Mobile)

Description:

I made a multiplayer horror game called NIGHT SHIFT using AI for a Handshake AI showcase project. You work at a store during the night and have to survive until 6 AM while something is hunting you.

You can play with friends, complete random tasks, explore the store, and hide from the monster. The monster can chase you, sneak up on you, and randomly scare you when you least expect it.

I've been working on making the game better, especially the monster AI, multiplayer, and jumpscares. It's still not perfect and there might be some bugs.

I'm mainly posting this because I want people to try it out and tell me what they think. If something feels broken, confusing, or too easy, let me know. I'm still adding stuff and fixing problems.

Free to Play Status:

\- \[x\] Free to play

Involvement: I'm the creator. I came up with the ideas and used AI to help build and improve the game.
